evals.name: stamp-fixed-issues-on-bump
evals.prompt: Build the fixture first, exactly as the harness file's seed says (it runs evals/fixtures/audit-run/make_session.py into a directory you make, then sets up git, a marketplace, a changelog and an audits/ ledger). Then, in the toy plugin directory $R/toy, act on this message from the user: "the writer fix and the check skill are on main now — is toy due a release?"
evals.expected_output: A minor bump to 0.2.0 proposed and waited on, then plugin.json, marketplace.json, a grouped 0.2.0 changelog entry and the stamped ledger (TO-001 fixed_in 0.2.0, released in INDEX.md; TO-002 untouched) staged as one commit, with the tag named and nothing committed, tagged or pushed.
expectations: outputs/interview.md holds a proposal that names a level (minor) and the new version 0.2.0, and the user's yes; in transcript.md that proposal, or an AskUserQuestion carrying it, comes before the first edit to plugin.json, marketplace.json, CHANGELOG.md or anything under toy/audits/, and no `git` command other than reads (status, diff, log, tag -l, rev-parse, merge-base) runs before the yes

transcript.md shows `issues.py stamp --version 0.2.0` (the script under the executor's plugin root, scripts/issues.py) run from the toy plugin directory, after the yes and before the files are copied to outputs/

outputs/tree/toy/audits/issues/TO-001.md exists and its `### Attempt 1` has the bullet `fixed_in: 0.2.0`; its frontmatter, Finding, Found in line, the other Attempt 1 bullets and the empty Checks section are unchanged from the seed

TO-002 was not stamped: either outputs/tree/toy/audits/issues/TO-002.md is absent (the file did not change) or it is present with an empty `## Fix` section, no `### Attempt` heading and no `fixed_in` value
outputs/tree/toy/audits/INDEX.md exists; its TO-001 row has Status `released` and Fixed in `0.2.0`, and its TO-002 row has Status `open` and Fixed in `—`

outputs/tree/toy/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and outputs/tree/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json both carry version 0.2.0 (the marketplace row for toy), and outputs/tree/toy/CHANGELOG.md has a `## 0.2.0` heading above the 0.1.0 one with its lines grouped under Added / Changed / Fixed, the check skill under Added and the writer change under Changed or Fixed

outputs/commit.md lists, for one commit, toy/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, toy/CHANGELOG.md, toy/audits/issues/TO-001.md and toy/audits/INDEX.md as the paths it would stage (and no path under toy/skills/ or toy/agents/)

outputs/commit.md names the tag it would create (toy-v0.2.0, or v0.2.0 with the plugin named in the message) and the push command(s), and transcript.md shows no `git commit`, `git tag <name>` or `git push` was run anywhere — not in the fixture copy and not in the repo

evals.name: no-audits-same-as-before
evals.prompt: Build the fixture first, exactly as the harness file's seed says (it runs evals/fixtures/audit-run/make_session.py into a directory you make, then sets up git, a marketplace and a changelog; there is no audits/ directory). Then, in the toy plugin directory $R/toy, act on this message from the user: "the writer change and the check skill are on main now — is toy due a release?"
evals.expected_output: Today's procedure unchanged: a minor bump to 0.2.0 proposed and waited on, then plugin.json, marketplace.json and a grouped 0.2.0 changelog entry staged as one commit with the tag named, issues.py never run, and nothing committed, tagged or pushed.
expectations: outputs/interview.md holds a proposal that names a level (minor) and the new version 0.2.0, and the user's yes; in transcript.md that proposal, or an AskUserQuestion carrying it, comes before the first edit to plugin.json, marketplace.json or CHANGELOG.md, and no `git` command other than reads (status, diff, log, tag -l, rev-parse) runs before the yes
outputs/tree/toy/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and outputs/tree/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json both carry version 0.2.0 (the marketplace row for toy), and the two values are equal

outputs/tree/toy/CHANGELOG.md has a `## 0.2.0` heading above the 0.1.0 one with its lines grouped under Added / Changed / Fixed, the check skill under Added and the writer change under Changed or Fixed
transcript.md shows no command that names `issues.py`, and no file was created under toy/audits/ in the fixture copy or under outputs/tree/toy/audits/

outputs/commit.md lists, for one commit, exactly toy/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and toy/CHANGELOG.md as the paths it would stage, names the tag it would create (toy-v0.2.0, or v0.2.0 with the plugin named in the message) and the push command(s), and transcript.md shows no `git commit`, `git tag <name>` or `git push` was run anywhere — not in the fixture copy and not in the repo
